  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Executive Overview from Cliff Pemble, President and Chief Executive Officer:</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;We achieved another quarter of record operating results driven by strength across markets and product categories, with meaningful contributions from recently launched products. Our results were further enhanced by strong operational execution resulting in record consolidated gross margin and impressive operating profit leverage. We are raising our 2026 outlook based on the results we have achieved so far and the momentum we are experiencing as we enter the important holiday selling season.&#x201d; - Cliff Pemble, President and Chief Executive Officer of Garmin Ltd.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Fitness:</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6.7pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Revenue from the fitness segment increased 16% in the third quarter with growth led by strong demand for wearables. Gross and operating margins were 63% and 33%, respectively, resulting in $231 million of operating income. During the quarter, we launched the CIRQA&#153; Smart Band, a screenless wearable offering rich wellness and fitness insights that expands our addressable market for wellness devices. In addition, we recently announced the next generation of Edge</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#174;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> cycling computers with the Edge 1060 featuring a built-in microphone and speaker for hands-free voice control capability and the Edge Explore 3 series, an easy-to-use bike computer for riders of all levels.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Outdoor:</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6.7pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Revenue from the outdoor segment increased 20% in the third quarter with growth primarily driven by adventure watches. Gross and operating margins were 68% and 39%, respectively, resulting in $233 million of operating income. During the quarter, we launched the f&#x113;nix 9 and f&#x113;nix 9 Pro series, with an all-titanium watch case option and the largest available AMOLED screen in our flagship adventure watch lineup. Also during the quarter, we launched the all-new Garmin Drive</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">TM</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> GPS navigators with high-resolution ultrawide format displays and an elevated user experience.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Aviation:</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6.7pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Revenue from the aviation segment increased 5% in the third quarter with growth primarily driven by OEM product categories. Gross and operating margins were 78% and 26%, respectively, resulting in $66 million of operating income. During the quarter, we unveiled the G2000</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#174;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> PRIME, bringing PRIME flight deck functionality to the high-performance piston and electric aircraft market. Also during the quarter, we announced the certification of an all-glass retrofit cockpit for the original Cessna CitationJet. Pilatus Aircraft and Epic Aircraft recently announced the certification of Garmin Autoland on the PC-12 Pro and the e1000 airplanes, respectively. We also made important updates to Garmin Pilot&#153;, adding SmartCharts coverage for Canada and Mexico, as well as Mobile Clearance Delivery which allows pilots to obtain clearances electronically through the Garmin Pilot app.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Marine:</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6.7pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Revenue from the marine segment increased 16% in the third quarter with broad-based growth across multiple categories, led by the sonar product category. Gross and operating margins were 64% and 30%, respectively, resulting in $94 million of operating income. During the quarter, we launched the next generation LiveScope</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">TM</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> 2, delivering live sonar images with improved range and clarity. Also during the quarter, we expanded our sailboat product lineup with the GMI</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">TM</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> 40 instrument display and the SmartDrive&#153; brushless linear steering actuator. We also launched the JL Audio A60 head unit series, and M200 speaker systems.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Auto OEM:</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Revenue from the auto OEM segment decreased 20% during the third quarter primarily due to domain controllers. Gross margin was 16% and we recorded an operating loss of $12 million in the quarter.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>

  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:6pt;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Additional Financial Information:</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The consolidated third quarter gross margin expanded 420 basis points to 63.3%, compared to the prior year quarter, with higher margins across all segments. The consolidated gross margin increase was primarily attributable to favorable segment mix, lower product cost, and approximately $33 million in refunds of previously paid tariffs.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Total operating expenses in the third quarter were $646 million, a 10% increase over the prior year. Research and development increased 9% driven primarily by personnel-related costs. Selling, general and administrative expenses increased 10%, driven primarily by personnel-related costs and advertising expenses.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The effective tax rate in the third quarter was 18.1%, compared to an effective tax rate of 21.2% in the prior year quarter. The decrease in the effective tax rate is primarily driven by an increase in expected U.S. deductions due to certain provisions of the U.S. tax legislation enacted in 2025 that became effective in 2026.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6.7pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">In the third quarter of 2026, we generated operating cash flows of $394 million and free cash flow</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(1)</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of $293 million. We paid a quarterly dividend of $202 million and repurchased $41 million of the Company&#x2019;s shares within the quarter, leaving approximately $407 million remaining as of September 26, 2026 in the $500 million share repurchase program authorized through December 2028. We ended the quarter with cash and marketable securities of approximately $4.1 billion.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p Management believes excluding purchases of property and equipment provides a better understanding of the underlying trends in the Company&#x2019;s operations and allows more accurate comparisons of the Company&#x2019;s results between periods. This metric may also be useful to investors but should not be considered in isolation as it is not a measure of cash flow available for discretionary expenditures. The most comparable GAAP measure is net cash provided by operating activities.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
